'''Great ibbots''' were a [[Species/Legends|subspecies]] of [[ibbot]]. They lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] and were used by the division of Drall police called the [[Wingriders]].<ref name="SoF" />

==Biology and appearance==
The great ibbot was the largest [[Bird/Legends|avian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on its [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]].<ref name="SoF" /> One of sixty-eight species of [[ibbot]] to live on the planet,<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> the majestic bird stood three to four [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and had a wingspan of more than ten meters.<ref name="SoF" />

The ibbots' feathers were usually [[Copper/Legends|copper]] and [[Brass/Legends|brass]] in [[Color/Legends|copper]] with highlights of black and brown. Their abdomens were white or cream-colored, as were the undersides of their wings.<ref name="SoF" />

The imposing birds were carnivorous,<ref name="SoF" /> in contrast to most other ibbots, which ate [[Algae/Legends|algae]].<ref name="CatCW" /> Specifically, the great ibbot ate [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] lifeforms, especially [[Fish/Legends|fish]].<ref name="SoF" />

==Behavior==
Great ibbots sometimes hunted large [[spikefish]] from Drall's lakes and seas. The birds waited for the fish to surface from the water to catch them. They also sometimes ate herd animals and the occasional pet.<ref name="SoF" />
